title: Asteroid Precovery: Reproducible Archive Evidence
summary: Local pilot reproducing two documented 1955 precovery exposures of 1999 AN10 with uncertainty, negative controls and a reviewable evidence package.

credit.policy: CONTRIBUTING.md; credit original observations, archives and catalogues. Contributors and reviewers are named only with consent.

requirements.note: Python 3.14 tested; no GPU; pinned wheels; offline astronomical verification after installation.

review.note: Public research proposal, paused to donated sessions. No scientific maintainer has consented and weekly review capacity is unassigned. Hub listing consent does not authorize scientific acceptance or contributor traffic. Placeholder maintainer entry is a vacant role required by v0 schema, not a person.
